description:
The Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Madhya Pradesh in India. 

This scheme was launched on 15th November 2012. 

It aims to provide senior citizens with the opportunity to visit religious pilgrimage sites. 

The scheme is particularly targeted at individuals aged 60 years and above. 

The primary objective is to promote religious tourism among the elderly population. 

The government aims to enhance the spiritual well-being of senior citizens through this initiative. 

Under this scheme, the government covers the travel expenses for eligible senior citizens. 

The scheme provides free travel to various religious sites across India. 

Eligible beneficiaries can visit places like Varanasi, Haridwar, and Ajmer Sharif. 

The scheme also includes visits to other significant pilgrimage sites. 

The government has set a target to facilitate the pilgrimage of 1 lakh senior citizens annually. 

Each eligible senior citizen can avail of this scheme once in their lifetime. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is substantial. 

The government covers the entire cost of the pilgrimage, including travel and accommodation. 

The maximum limit for the travel cost is set at ₹10,000 per person. 

The scheme also includes provisions for food and other necessary expenses. 

To be eligible for this scheme, applicants must be residents of Madhya Pradesh. 

They must be aged 60 years or older at the time of application. 

There are no specific income criteria for eligibility. 

However, priority is given to economically weaker sections of society. 

The application process is straightforward and accessible. 

Interested individuals must fill out an application form available at local government offices. 

The form can also be downloaded from the official website of the Madhya Pradesh government. 

Applicants are required to submit a copy of their age proof document. 

This can include documents like a birth certificate or an Aadhar card. 

Additionally, applicants must provide proof of residence in Madhya Pradesh. 

Once the application is submitted, it is verified by the concerned authorities. 

The verification process typically takes about 15 days. 

After verification, eligible applicants are notified about their pilgrimage schedule. 

The government organizes the travel arrangements for the beneficiaries. 

Travel is conducted in comfortable buses or trains, depending on the distance. 

The scheme also ensures that senior citizens are accompanied by trained volunteers. 

These volunteers assist the elderly during the pilgrimage. 

The government has made provisions for medical assistance during the journey. 

In case of any medical emergencies, arrangements are in place for immediate care. 

The Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan Yojana has seen significant participation since its inception. 

In the year 2020, over 50,000 senior citizens availed of the scheme. 

The scheme has been praised for promoting inclusivity and accessibility. 

It has also fostered a sense of community among the elderly. 

The Madhya Pradesh government has allocated a budget of ₹50 crore for this scheme annually. 

This budget is utilized for travel arrangements, accommodation, and other expenses. 

The scheme has been instrumental in enhancing the quality of life for many senior citizens. 

It provides them with an opportunity to fulfill their spiritual aspirations. 

The Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan Yojana is implemented by the Department of Religious Trust and Endowments. 

This department is responsible for overseeing the operations and logistics of the scheme. 

Individuals can contact the department for more information at the following address: 

Department of Religious Trust and Endowments, Government of Madhya Pradesh, Bhopal. 

The contact number for inquiries is 0755-244-0000. 

The scheme has been well-received by the public and has garnered positive feedback. 

Many beneficiaries have expressed their gratitude for the opportunity to visit holy sites. 

The government regularly reviews the scheme to enhance its effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements. 

The Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan Yojana is a testament to the government's commitment to the welfare of senior citizens. 

It underscores the importance of spiritual fulfillment in the lives of the elderly. 

The scheme continues to evolve to meet the needs of the aging population. 

In conclusion, the Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan Yojana is a significant initiative. 

It provides a valuable service to senior citizens in Madhya Pradesh. 

By facilitating religious pilgrimages, the scheme promotes cultural heritage and spiritual well-being. 

The government remains dedicated to ensuring that every eligible senior citizen can benefit from this initiative. 

This scheme exemplifies the government's proactive approach to social welfare. 

Overall, the Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan Yojana stands as a model for similar initiatives across India.
